title: Inter should rotate half this team vs Club Brugge — and Gazzetta expects six changes
caption: Inter host Club Brugge at San Siro today, and Chivu should rotate half this team. Chivu confirmed "we'll make a few changes" and said Çalhanoğlu is fit, per Inter.it; La Gazzetta dello Sport expects six of them, with a first Inter start for Aleksandar Stanković, back from a season at Club Brugge. Sky Sport Italia gives that deep midfield role to Çalhanoğlu instead.
